title: Topic 4: Describing People - Reading
description: Two short texts with three questions each.
canDoStatement: Describe a person's appearance and personality simply

readingBlock.readingText:
TEXT A - Lost person notice format
HELP! WHERE IS MY GRANDFATHER?
His name is Sr. Adao. He is 80 years old.
He is short and he has short hair.
His eyes are small. He is very nice.
Please call: 9 8 7 6.

TEXT B - Chat messages format
Zeca: Is your new teacher nice?
Lia:  Yes! Her name is Dona Fatima. She is very nice.
Zeca: What does she look like?
Lia:  She is tall. She has long hair and big eyes.
Zeca: My teacher is her brother!

readingQuestions.question: What is this notice for?
options: To say hello to a class
